headline: Gulveer Singh and Harjinder Kaur added silver medals for India on Day 5 of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, boosting the nation’s tally in athletics events.
India’s overall medal tally at the 2026 Commonwealth Games reached 39 medals, surpassing pre‑event expectations and placing the country among the top‑ranked nations.
The Indian women’s cricket team secured its berth for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics after winning the qualification series, confirming India’s place at the upcoming Games.
Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted India’s aggressive push to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining new infrastructure projects and international lobbying efforts.

headline: The Badminton Association of India released its 2026 Asian Games squad, featuring PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen and the Satwik‑Chirag pair as headline players for the event in Aichi‑Nagoya.
